gloss: person with time on their hands; idler

definitions.gloss: person with time on their hands; idler
definitions.explanation: Someone with plenty of free time and nothing much to do. Usually teasing or mildly scornful ("you must have nothing better to do"), and often used of oneself with a laugh.

examples.japanese: ⟦{僕|ぼく}→僕：01729_boku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暇人|ひまじん}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧。
examples.english: Well, I've got nothing better to do.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{暇人|ひまじん}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Looking that up? You really have time on your hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{暇人|ひまじん}になった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{忙|いそが}しそうだ。
examples.english: My father laughs that he has become a man of leisure since retiring, but in fact he seems busy every day.

notes:
Said to someone else it is a jab, so keep it for friends; said of oneself it is modest and humorous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暇人|ひまじん}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: you've got too much time on your hands
- {暇人|ひまじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暇|ひま}つぶし→暇つぶし：16684_himatsubushi⟧: an idle person's way of killing time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧: free time; the word it is built on
